personality.summary: Polite, restrained and compassionate, yet absolute as a swordswoman once she recognizes an opponent's resolve.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Initially treats him as a child but recognizes him as a man and swordsman after he insists on protecting Shizuku's wish; hopes to meet him again as a rival.
relationships.wallenstein: Staying at the same Akatsuki base; not part of the conspiracy but blocks intruders out of courtesy.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Knows Kurono and tells her to relay a message to Ikki.

periods.summary: Edelweiss appears at Akatsuki's base as a temporary guest, not a conspirator. Her mere sword aura halts Kurono and Nene at a distance and terrifies Ikki, who recognizes her as the world's strongest swordswoman. Ikki uses Ittou Shura and every secret sword he has, but she overwhelms him with silent, lossless dual-blade swordsmanship and shatters Intetsu. When Ikki continues because Shizuku entrusted him with her wish, Edelweiss recognizes him as a swordsman, takes the fight seriously, and defeats him without killing him. Kurono later discovers that Ikki's final strike still left a few drops of Edelweiss's blood.

key_events.summary: Defeats Ikki after acknowledging his resolve, while receiving a tiny wound.

periods.time: Final day before and during the Seven Stars final
periods.label: 见证新未来的比翼
periods.affiliation: independent; connected to Akatsuki members as acquaintance

status.current: recognizes Ikki's awakening and the birth of a new future
status.condition: calm observer who warns of international agents

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent and future possible adversary; she recognizes him as having stepped into awakening.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Future world-level talent whose final she observes with interest.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Meets him to attend the final and discuss the future he has foreseen.

periods.summary: Edelweiss contacts Tsukikage to watch the final in person after seeing Ikki and Stella's semifinal growth. She warns that agents from multiple powers are already in the venue and that such figures may try to remove future threats. During the final she identifies Ikki's fear, recognizes when he reaches his fate-bound limit, then is shocked as he increases his magic and steps into the realm of awakened fate-transcenders. After the final, she tells Tsukikage that Ikki and Stella may oppose the despair-filled future and that other Majin will also recognize the new future created there.

key_events.summary: Arrives to observe Ikki and Stella and warns of foreign agents.
Recognizes Ikki's impossible magic increase as an awakening beyond fate.
Frames Ikki and Stella as possible counters to Tsukikage's foreseen future.

periods.time: During a brief rest at Edelberg

status.current: ends her vacation and prepares to move against the world crisis
status.condition: calm, amused by the younger generation, and morally engaged

relationships.stella-vermillion: Initially refuses Stella's suicidal challenge, then creates a trial to make her accumulate real strength.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Respects Ikki's sword and trains his magic control; thanks him for saving Amane.
relationships.alice-ascaride: Recognizes Alice and includes her in the Rule of Graces oath.
relationships.fu-xiaoli: Knows Xiaoli as a dangerous Desperado and moves to intervene before Ikki stops her.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: References the world crisis shown by Tsukikage's vision.

periods.summary: Edelweiss explains her origin as a girl whose sword talent turned her into a state-level threat after the Baltic crisis. At her Edelberg home she refuses Stella's challenge because Stella is trying to die rather than win, demonstrating Desperado causal dominance by injuring Stella with killing intent alone. To give Stella a safer route to growth, she invokes Rule of Graces and asks Stella to hold Fifth Camp for five days without help in exchange for a duel. She also welcomes Ikki, feeds him sweets, discusses her search for her own chivalry, thanks him for saving Amane Shinomiya, and trains his magic control atop Edelberg. When Xiaoli appears, Edelweiss prepares to save Stella but is stopped by Ikki's oath. After Stella's awakening, Edelweiss praises her, accepts Stella's withdrawal, and later ends her vacation to act on the coming world collapse.

key_events.summary: Forms the Rule of Graces contract with Stella and her companions.
Guides Ikki to compress magic rather than copy her sword.
Attempts to intervene against Xiaoli but is blocked by Ikki.

periods.time: After the Tokyo defense, at the Tatra base
periods.label: 追寻暴君遗体的比翼

status.current: buried in Arlanz's hangar collapse with Nango and Fu Xiaoli; survival unresolved in this volume
status.condition: wounded from fighting many Abraham clones

relationships.torajiro-nango: Old acquaintance through Ryoma; teams with him to investigate the Tyrant's corpse.
relationships.fu-xiaoli: Saved Xiaoli in the Alps and is followed by her as repayment.
relationships.ryoma-kurogane: Teacher whose will and sword guide Edelweiss's attempt to save lives.
relationships.adam-goetia: Investigates the missing corpse and discovers Arlanz has stolen his Device.

periods.summary: Edelweiss notices Union movements across Europe and goes to the ruined Rebellion base to confirm the Tyrant's condition before war can use him as a spark. Finding the throne room empty, she follows magical traces to the Tatra base and meets Nango, with Fu Xiaoli tagging along out of gratitude. She joins the raid against PSYON and uses Sacred Order to seize temporary command of wounded Abraham clones, protecting Nango during his rush at Arlanz. She then learns Blutsauger is missing and is caught in Arlanz's collapse trap.

key_events.summary: Joins Nango and Xiaoli in attacking the base to inspect the Tyrant's body.
Uses Sacred Order during the fight and is buried in the trap after Blutsauger's theft is revealed.

abilities: magic armor woven from remaining magic

personality.summary: Edelweiss acts neither for Union nor League but for her own justice. She is severe when Ikki abandons tomorrow, gentle toward Stella's gratitude, and strategically wise enough to assign Eilands' true body to Xiaoli for political and tactical reasons.
values: saving as many lives as possible
strength that does not become a cause of war
flaws: admits she acted too late against Eilands
her status makes accepting state protection politically dangerous

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Student/rival she once trained; stops his self-destructive killing intent and reminds him of his real strength.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Comes to save her and later receives Stella's gratitude and offer of Vermillion protection.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Entrusts the rescue to Shizuku's plan and praises her as the bravest and smartest knight there.
relationships.karl-eilands: Had investigated him, survived his trap, and arranges his final destruction through Xiaoli.
relationships.fu-xiaoli: Sends Xiaoli to destroy Eilands' true brain in Yellowstone.
relationships.norman-creed: Arrives in Japan through his teleportation after Union leadership chooses not to formally intervene.

periods.summary: Edelweiss survives the earlier base self-destruction with Nango and has been investigating Eilands as a threat born from the Rebellion system. Norman Creed brings her to Japan because formal Union action would be politically slow and divisive. At the critical moment she intercepts Ikki's Excessive Awakening strike against possessed Stella, cuts off his horn and condemns his self-destructive abandonment of tomorrow. After Shizuku proves Stella remains reachable, Edelweiss suppresses Eilands-possessed Stella long enough for Shizuku to fuse Ikki into Stella, using Sacred Order and later Sword of Cosmos to stop Calusaritio Salamander even with one arm wounded. After Stella awakens, Edelweiss declines asylum in Vermillion because her independence prevents her strength from becoming a political spark, though she accepts the sentiment and makes a small future request.

key_events.summary: Arrives through Norman Creed and volunteers to reinforce the rescue under her own justice.
Stops Ikki from killing possessed Stella and opens the route for Shizuku's fusion plan.
Holds Eilands-possessed Stella with Sword of Cosmos while Ikki works inside Stella's mind.
Receives Stella's thanks and explains why she remains an independent free sword.
